card.name: Month or weekday before a date
card.fires_on: Month names and weekday names that sit inside a date or time phrase, such as after 'In', 'March ' or a news caption. It also fires on the day number in a date.

modes.label: Month name
modes.description: A month name (or the space after it) that comes before a year or a comma.
modes.example: Date reviewed: March<< >>2010 Have a question

modes.label: Weekday in news caption
modes.description: A weekday ending a photo or news caption to say when something happened.
modes.example: Attorney General Eric Holder pauses as he testifies on Capitol Hill before the House Judiciary Committee<< Wednesday>>.

modes.label: Month after In
modes.description: A month name right after 'In' at the start of a clause.
modes.example: In<< January>> I wrote an essay for Cyborgology

card.writes: It suppresses other month names and day words, so it seems to stop the model repeating a month right after one was given.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a month or weekday has just been given in a date.
